sources.title: wan3.0-video-prime model information - Alibaba Cloud
sources.snippet: Wan3.0-Video-Prime is the accelerated version of the Wan video generation model, delivering significantly faster generation speed while maintaining high-quality output. It supports multi-modal inputs including text, image, video, and audio, enabling text-to-video, image-to-video (first frame/first-last frame), and reference-based video generation within a single model. sources.title: Wan 3.0 Video Prime API – Fast Wan AI Video | Kie AI
sources.snippet: Wan 3.0 Video Prime is a high-speed AI video generation model from Alibaba's Wan model family. It delivers core capabilities aligned with Wan 3.0 Video while offering faster end-to-end generation, with multimodal references across audio, image, text, and video and video generation up to 30 seconds.
